acceptanceCriteria.ac: Given `get_portfolio` tool with `include_prices=true`, when called, then tool fetches current prices for all tickers in a single batch via yfinance and enriches each holding with current_price, current_value, cost_basis, gain_loss, and gain_loss_pct
Given `get_portfolio` without `include_prices` (or `include_prices=false`), then tool returns original response format without price fetching for fast "what do I own?" queries

Given portfolio with multiple holdings, when prices requested, then tool uses single batch call to yfinance (not N individual calls), handles partial failures gracefully, and caches prices for 5 minutes in Redis
Given user asks "how is my portfolio doing?", then Annie calls `get_portfolio` with `include_prices=true` and responds with portfolio value, total gain/loss, and highlights top/worst performers
Given price fetch fails for some tickers, then tool returns holdings with `current_price: null` for failed tickers and includes `price_fetch_errors` array with failed ticker list

doc.title: Epic 10: Portfolio Management & Financial Tools
doc.snippet: Enhance `get_portfolio` tool with optional `include_prices` parameter. Use yfinance batch download for efficiency. Cache prices 5 min in Redis. LLM calculates top/worst performers from enriched data.

doc.title: Project Overview and Development Guidelines
doc.snippet: Backend communicates with MCP Server via JSON-RPC 2.0. Tool handlers in mcp_server/tools.py with schemas. Follow existing patterns for portfolio tools.

doc.title: API Specifications
doc.snippet: MCP tools exposed via /tools/call POST endpoint. Tool handlers return JSON with status, data, and error fields.

python.package: Yahoo Finance API wrapper for stock data
DataFrame handling for yfinance batch response
Async Redis client for price caching (via redis.asyncio)

external.service: Yahoo Finance stock prices (no API key needed)

constraints.constraint: Follow existing tool handler pattern in mcp_server/tools.py - use normalize_ticker(), proper error handling, and structured logging
include_prices defaults to False - existing callers must work unchanged
Batch fetch prices in single yfinance.download() call - never N individual calls
Redis cache with 5-minute TTL (300s) - match PortfolioManager.PORTFOLIO_CACHE_TTL pattern
Partial failures: return null for failed tickers, include price_fetch_errors array
Enhance existing get_portfolio tool, do NOT create new tool
